Album.description: Albums in the Chinook music catalog. Join to Artist for the performer and to Track for the album's tracks.
query_hints: Join Artist on ArtistId when an artist name is needed.
Join Track on AlbumId to count tracks or connect albums to invoice lines.
sample_queries: SELECT ar.Name AS Artist, COUNT(*) AS AlbumCount FROM Album AS al JOIN Artist AS ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY AlbumCount DESC LIMIT 10

Artist.description: Artists represented in the Chinook music catalog.

important_columns.Name: Artist or group name; may be null

query_hints: Join through Album and Track to connect artists to tracks or sales.
Use LEFT JOIN when retaining artists that have no matching albums or sales matters.
sample_queries: SELECT ArtistId, Name FROM Artist ORDER BY Name LIMIT 50

Customer.description: Fictional Chinook store customers with contact, company, address, geography, and assigned support representative data.
query_hints: Join Invoice on CustomerId for customer purchasing and revenue analysis.
Join Employee on SupportRepId to analyze support representative portfolios.
Customer geography describes the customer; Invoice billing fields describe a specific sale.
sample_queries: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC, Country

Employee.description: Fictional Chinook employees, including customer support representatives and a self-referencing reporting hierarchy.
query_hints: Use a self-join with distinct aliases to show an employee and manager.
Join Customer on SupportRepId, then Invoice on CustomerId, for support representative sales analysis.
sample_queries: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS Employee, e.Title, m.FirstName || ' ' || m.LastName AS Manager FROM Employee AS e LEFT JOIN Employee AS m ON m.EmployeeId = e.ReportsTo ORDER BY e.EmployeeId

Genre.description: Lookup of genres used to classify tracks in the Chinook catalog.
query_hints: Join Track on GenreId, then InvoiceLine on TrackId, to analyze genre sales.
Use LEFT JOIN when genres with no tracks or sales must remain visible.
sample_queries: SELECT g.Name AS Genre, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Genre AS g LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC

Invoice.description: Chinook sales invoice headers. The fixed sample covers 2009-01-01 through 2013-12-22 and stores invoice-level totals and billing geography.
Invoice.data_window: 2009-01-01 through 2013-12-22; the latest represented sales year is 2013.

important_columns.BillingState: Billing state or region for this invoice

query_hints: Use SUM(Invoice.Total) for invoice-level revenue when no line-item attributes are needed.
Do not sum Invoice.Total after joining InvoiceLine unless invoices are deduplicated first; the join repeats the header for every line.
For line, track, album, artist, or genre analysis, use SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity) as realized revenue.
For dataset-relative phrases such as 'latest year' or 'last year' without an explicit date, anchor the period to the latest represented InvoiceDate, 2013-12-22. State this assumption in the answer.
Treat explicit years and dates literally. A user-specified year outside 2009-2013 may correctly return no rows.
SQLite can group by year with strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate).
sample_queries: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS Revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS SalesYear, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS Revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY SalesYear ORDER BY SalesYear

InvoiceLine.description: Line items on Chinook invoices, recording the sold track, realized unit price, and quantity.
InvoiceLine.grain: One row per track line on an invoice.

important_columns.UnitPrice: Realized unit price on this sale

query_hints: Calculate line revenue as UnitPrice * Quantity and aggregate that expression for track, album, artist, genre, or media-type revenue.
Use SUM(Quantity) for units sold and COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceId) for invoice count.
Join Invoice for dates, customers, and billing geography; join Track for catalog attributes.
sample_queries: SELECT TrackId, SUM(Quantity) AS UnitsSold, ROUND(SUM(UnitPrice * Quantity), 2) AS Revenue FROM InvoiceLine GROUP BY TrackId ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 10

MediaType.description: Lookup of media formats used by tracks, such as MPEG audio, AAC audio, and protected video.
query_hints: Join Track on MediaTypeId for catalog counts, then InvoiceLine on TrackId for sales analysis.
sample_queries: SELECT mt.Name AS MediaType, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM MediaType AS mt LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC

Playlist.description: Named playlists in the Chinook catalog.

important_columns.Name: Playlist name; names are not guaranteed to be unique

query_hints: Join PlaylistTrack on PlaylistId, then Track on TrackId, to inspect membership.
Group by PlaylistId as well as Name because different playlists can share a name.
sample_queries: SELECT p.PlaylistId, p.Name AS Playlist, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Playlist AS p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack AS pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId, p.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC

PlaylistTrack.description: Bridge table representing membership of tracks in playlists.
PlaylistTrack.grain: One row per unique playlist and track pair.

column_types.PlaylistId: INTEGER NOT NULL COMPOSITE PRIMARY KEY
column_types.TrackId: INTEGER NOT NULL COMPOSITE PRIMARY KEY

query_hints: This table contains no sales facts; it describes playlist membership only.
Count rows per PlaylistId for playlist size or distinct PlaylistId values per TrackId for playlist reach.
sample_queries: SELECT TrackId, COUNT(*) AS PlaylistCount FROM PlaylistTrack GROUP BY TrackId ORDER BY PlaylistCount DESC LIMIT 10

Track.description: Tracks in the Chinook catalog with album, genre, media format, composer, duration, file size, and catalog unit price.

important_columns.Name: Track name
important_columns.Bytes: File size in bytes; may be null
important_columns.UnitPrice: Current catalog price, not necessarily the realized historical sale price

query_hints: Use InvoiceLine.UnitPrice rather than Track.UnitPrice for realized sales revenue.
Join Album, then Artist, for artist attribution.
Use LEFT JOIN for nullable AlbumId or GenreId when preserving all tracks matters.
Divide Milliseconds by 60000.0 for duration in minutes.
sample_queries: SELECT t.Name AS Track, ar.Name AS Artist, ROUND(t.Milliseconds / 60000.0, 2) AS Minutes FROM Track AS t LEFT JOIN Album AS al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId LEFT JOIN Artist AS ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId ORDER BY t.Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 10
